definition:
An active [threat](/term/threat) that incentivizes a response from the opponent. A [player](/term/player) with pressure threatens the enemy to respond, and if left unanswered will create an advantage. Pressure punishes inaction and increases [tension](/term/tension); under pressure, players are more likely to make uncharacteristic decisions and actions. Pressure can be applied at all game scales. 

Example: a laner applies pressure to their opponent by denying minions, a splitpusher applies pressure to the map by pushing waves, and a team applies pressure to the enemy by starting a neutral objective.
